market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a far-left activist with no national electoral track record and minimal vote share; he would need to outperform Lula (incumbent) or major center-right candidates for second place, which is extraordinarily unlikely. Current polling and historical data suggest his chance of finishing second is <1%, far below the 7.3% implied by the market price.
evidence_points: Santos leads MTST, not a broad electoral coalition, and has never won elected office.
Major presidential contenders (Lula, likely a Bolsonaro-backed candidate, Ciro Gomes) absorb most votes in first-round polling.
In 2022, no PSOL candidate ran; the party's support is concentrated behind Lula or Boulos, not a third-tier figure.
sources_consulted: News articles discussing Renan Santos's presidential ambitions
